project.title: Sequencing of water samples from drinking water treatment plants
project.description: This study investigates microbial community composition and dynamics in water samples from a drinking water treatment plant (DWTP) using high-throughput sequencing. Samples were collected from raw water, coagulation, sedimentation, filtration, and disinfection stages. The objectives include tracking microbial diversity changes along the treatment train, identifying potential opportunistic pathogens, and assessing treatment efficiency for microbial removal. The dataset comprises raw reads from DNA extracted across multiple time points and process units.
